proxy.name: Proxy
proxy.description: This player activates an Alien upon death

roleInfo.name: Regular Mafia
roleInfo.description: You will get to know your fellow Mafia once the game starts. Choose someone to kill every night!

roleInfo.name: Axe
roleInfo.description: You will get to know your fellow Mafia once the game starts. Choose someone to kill every night! Additionally, you must axe a player's hand (vote) or tongue (voice). You cannot axe the same player two nights in a row.

roleInfo.name: Bomb
roleInfo.description: You will get to know your fellow Mafia once the game starts. Choose someone to kill every night! Additionally, kill another player when you die. You cannot activate this ability if you are the last Mafia role left alive.

roleInfo.name: Flirt
roleInfo.description: You do NOT know your fellow Mafia. Every night, choose a player to flirt with. That player will not be able to perform ANY of their active night actions. If you are the last surviving Mafia, you acquire the ability to kill at night. You NEVER show up as Mafia when checked by the Police Officer.

roleInfo.name: Hunter
roleInfo.description: Kill another player when you die! You cannot activate this ability if you are the last Town role left alive.

roleInfo.name: Police Officer
roleInfo.description: Check a player every night to learn if they are Mafia. The Flirt does NOT show up as Mafia.

roleInfo.name: Grand Inquisitor
roleInfo.description: Check a player every night to learn if they are in the Cult. When you die, you can fire a silver bullet at any player. If you fire the bullet at the a Cultist, they die, otherwise the bullet does nothing. If the Cult tries to recruit you, you will die in the morning and cannot be saved.

roleInfo.name: Doctor
roleInfo.description: Every night you will see the Mafia's target. Once in the entire game, you can choose to save that target, after which you have no more night actions.

roleInfo.name: Traveler
roleInfo.description: You may travel at night, making you immune from Mafia kills and Cult recruitment. You cannot travel two nights in a row. If you have a Lover, your Lover travels with you ("the honeymoon rule").

roleInfo.name: Cupid
roleInfo.description: You introduce Lovers into the game on Night 0. The Lovers are 2 players who die together, and if they start off on different teams, they become their own new team called the Lovers. You can either make yourself a Lover with a player of your choice, or you can choose to randomize the Lovers, in which case 2 players who are not you will become the Lovers.

roleInfo.name: Townsperson
roleInfo.description: Figure out who the Mafia are before they kill everyone in the Town!

roleInfo.name: Thief
roleInfo.description: You will see the two leftover roles and choose to become one of them. The other role is permanently missing from the game. If at least one of the leftover roles is a Mafia role, you MUST choose it.

roleInfo.name: Doppelganger
roleInfo.description: Choose to be any role in the game. You take your actions independently unless you choose to be a Mafia or a Cult Leader. If you choose to be an Alien, you become a new team of 1.

roleInfo.name: Cult Leader
roleInfo.description: Every night, you may either recruit a new player to the Cult, or you may disband the Cult. If you die and your most recent action was to recruit someone, all Cult members die with you. If you die and your most recent action was to disband the Cult, only you die, and your oldest surviving recruit becomes the new Cult Leader (in addition to the role they already have). Recruiting the Grand Inquisitor kills them instantly, allowing them to fire their silver bullet.

roleInfo.name: Alien
roleInfo.description: During Night 0, choose any player to be your Proxy. If your Proxy is targeted at night, they survive and you become activated. If your Proxy dies in any way while you are still alive, you become activated and your activation is publicly announced. You must get executed while activated to win the game for your team.

roleInfo.name: Doppelganging Alien
roleInfo.description: During Night 0, choose any player to be your Proxy. If your Proxy is targeted at night, they survive and you become activated. If your Proxy dies in any way while you are still alive, you become activated and your activation is publicly announced. You must get executed while activated to win the game for your team.

preset.header: Since the Activated Alien isn't in the Cult...
preset.text:
... and the Cult doesn't have a voting majority, the Cult has no way to win during exiling. Any remaining Cultists will now be killed.

Don't join the Cult kids.

All the Mafia are dead, but an Activated Alien is still alive.

You have 2 opportunities to exile them. Exiling works just like executions, but there are no nominations and defenses. The extra 0.5 votes is given to the player who currently has the most cash.

If the Alien survives both exiles, their team wins! Otherwise the Town wins.
